# NDI SDK headers

Unmodified headers from the official NDI SDK 6.3.2 distribution, retrieved
2026-09-21 from:

https://downloads.ndi.tv/SDK/NDI_SDK_Linux/Install_NDI_SDK_v6_Linux.tar.gz

Archive SHA-256:
`f0314f245446defc488b63ceb4689acf1a965aeefdadacb70571bb216a8cc183`

Each header includes its MIT license and Vizrt NDI AB copyright notice. That
license applies to the headers, not the NDI runtime or the SDK as a whole.
The runtime is loaded dynamically and is not tracked in this repository.
